resources.string: Add the Stopwatch toy and set it as the always-on Glyph Toy, or arm the timer here. Then place the phone face down to start it. Volume down once to pause or resume, twice to restart from zero. Pick the phone up to stop.
Glyph Toys manager not found. Update the phone\'s system software.
Counts up while the phone is face down. Volume down pauses; twice restarts.
Place the phone face down to start.
Lets volume down pause, resume and restart the Glyph Stopwatch while it is running. Volume keys work normally at all other times.
